crash.title: This window stopped on an error
crash.body: Download a bug report and send it yourself with what you were doing, what you expected and what happened instead. Then reload the window to carry on.

steps.reproduceBody: Reproduce the problem, then download the report soon after: newer log entries replace older ones.
steps.downloadBody: Saves a <0>{{file}}</0> file on this PC. Nothing is uploaded or sent anywhere.
steps.sendBody: Attach the file to your report with what you did, what you expected and what happened instead.

included.title: Included
included.version: App version and build, Windows version
included.errors: Recent errors and warnings from the app and every window
included.counters: Capture counters, group readiness and a few app settings
included.windows: Window positions, sizes and visibility, and the webview version

excluded.title: Not collected
excluded.account: Your account login or environment variables

actions.started: <0>Download started:</0> <1>{{file}}</1>. It is saved like any other download, usually in your Downloads folder. Attach it to your report with a description, the steps to reproduce and the result you expected.
actions.startedPartial: <0>Download started:</0> <1>{{file}}</1>. It is saved like any other download, usually in your Downloads folder. It holds only this window’s log, because the app could not add its own. Attach it to your report with a description, the steps to reproduce and the result you expected.
actions.failed: The bug report could not be made: {{error}}
actions.partialHint: You can still save this window’s own log and send that instead.

review: <0>Review it before you share it.</0> The file is plain JSON you can open in any text editor. It includes game character names and IDs (yours and other players’). Local folder paths, web addresses and common password or token fields are removed on a best-effort basis, but error messages can still hold unexpected text.

panel.title: Report a bug
panel.description: Save a diagnostics file to send with a bug report. It is made on this PC and never uploaded.
panel.needsDesktop: Bug reports need the desktop app. This preview has no app log to export.
